about: The search's 'needs' layer: everyday ways people describe a problem (say), mapped to the 1-3 best pages or tools (go: [address, why this helps]). tools/search/build_index.py checks every address, follows any address that is now a redirect stub to the page it moved to, adds each page's title and whether one person can use it alone, and writes assets/js/search-needs.js. Order the go list best first, with things one person can start alone before two-person tools. chips: the 'What's going on?' buttons shown when the search box is empty, solo needs first. syn: words that mean the same thing for matching (the first word is the one they all become).
